Welcome to the learning materials for the RAP Accelerator. Each session has pre-learning (required self-study before the session) and slides (used during the 1-hour session). You'll apply what you learn to your own project in the [capstone](5_capstone/index.qmd).


| Session | Focus | Objectives | Pre-learning | Slides |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ♻️ Reusable | Write modular, well-documented code that's easy for you and others to understand and reuse | [Objectives](1_reusable/index.qmd) | [Pre-learning](1_reusable/pre-learning.qmd) | [Slides](1_reusable/slides.qmd) |
| 📖 Visible | Make your projects easy to find and use with clear READMEs, licenses, and documentation | [Objectives](2_visible/index.qmd) | [Pre-learning](2_visible/pre-learning.qmd) | [Slides](2_visible/slides.qmd) |
| 👥 Collaborative | Work effectively with others using Git, code review, and good communication habits | [Objectives](3_collaborative/index.qmd) | [Pre-learning](3_collaborative/pre-learning.qmd) | [Slides](3_collaborative/slides.qmd) |
| 🛡️ Reliable | Build trust in your code through testing, automation, and reproducible environments | [Objectives](4_reliable/index.qmd) | [Pre-learning](4_reliable/pre-learning.qmd) | [Slides](4_reliable/slides.qmd) |
| 🏆 Capstone | Put it all into practice on a real project with feedback and support | [Objectives](5_capstone/index.qmd) | - | - |
